edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 32,000,000 by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within ten business days after both parties execute this Agreement.
edits.name: Payment amount and mechanics

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the payment specified in Section 1, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the dispute resolved by this Agreement, whether known or unknown, through the date of execution of this Agreement. This release does not apply to obligations under this Agreement.
edits.name: Dispute-limited release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers, as reasonably necessary for tax reporting or regulatory compliance, or as required by law, regulation, court order, or other legal process. A party making a disclosure to an adviser shall inform the adviser of the confidential nature of the terms.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions
